_readme: S444 (SkyBlueOak): MiraCosta's sitemap lists 286 program pages, yet the capture read 48 pages in 1,427 s and found 29 of 161 programs with a course list; the 43 page-claimed all had only the general education plan pages as candidates. How does a discipline page print each award, and where do the degree pages sit?

questions.discipline_awards: On a discipline page, how is each award headed, and does a tab or a child page hold its course list?
questions.program_addresses: What addresses do the discipline page's award links take (a child page per award, or an anchor)?
